scenes.title: Intro
scenes.narration: This is LegalMind, an AI-powered workspace that connects clients with their lawyers.
scenes.subtitle: This is LegalMind, an AI-powered workspace that connects clients with their lawyers.

scenes.title: Landing and sign in
scenes.narration: LegalMind gives clients, lawyers and admins their own role-based workspace, secured with JWT authentication. Let's sign in as a client first.
scenes.subtitle: LegalMind gives clients, lawyers and admins their own role-based workspace, secured with JWT authentication. Let's sign in as a client first.

scenes.title: Client creates a case
scenes.narration: From the client portal, Maya opens a new case in seconds. She gives it a title, picks a lawyer from the firm's directory, chooses the case type, and describes the problem in her own words. Tags make the case easy to find later, and it now appears on her dashboard and case list.
scenes.subtitle: From the client portal, Maya opens a new case in seconds. She gives it a title, picks a lawyer from the firm's directory, chooses the case type, and describes the problem in her own words. Tags make the case easy to find later, and it now appears on her dashboard and case list.

scenes.title: Client uploads evidence
scenes.narration: Supporting evidence is attached straight to the case. Here she uploads her lease agreement, and the backend extracts its text and indexes it for AI search in the background.
scenes.subtitle: Supporting evidence is attached straight to the case. Here she uploads her lease agreement, and the backend extracts its text and indexes it for AI search in the background.

scenes.title: Switch to the lawyer
scenes.narration: Now let's switch sides and sign in as her lawyer, Daniel. His dashboard summarizes active and closed cases at a glance, and Maya's new case is already assigned to him, with her details, the case type and tags.
scenes.subtitle: Now let's switch sides and sign in as her lawyer, Daniel. His dashboard summarizes active and closed cases at a glance, and Maya's new case is already assigned to him, with her details, the case type and tags.

scenes.title: Real-time chat
scenes.narration: Lawyers and clients talk in real time over Socket.IO. Every case has its own private conversation room. Daniel sends Maya an update, and her reply from her own device appears instantly.
scenes.subtitle: Lawyers and clients talk in real time over Socket.IO. Every case has its own private conversation room. Daniel sends Maya an update, and her reply from her own device appears instantly.

scenes.title: AI document summary
scenes.narration: Instead of reading every page, Daniel opens the document library and asks Gemini for a summary of the lease. Within seconds he has the key terms: rent, the security deposit, notice periods and repair duties.
scenes.subtitle: Instead of reading every page, Daniel opens the document library and asks Gemini for a summary of the lease. Within seconds he has the key terms: rent, the security deposit, notice periods and repair duties.

scenes.title: RAG search
scenes.narration: RAG search goes a step further. Daniel asks a specific question, the most relevant passages are retrieved from a Pinecone vector index, and Gemini answers using those passages, which are shown alongside the answer.
scenes.subtitle: RAG search goes a step further. Daniel asks a specific question, the most relevant passages are retrieved from a Pinecone vector index, and Gemini answers using those passages, which are shown alongside the answer.

scenes.title: AI legal assistant
scenes.narration: For broader questions there is the AI legal assistant, a conversational chat that keeps context across messages. Daniel asks what a tenant can do when repair requests are ignored, and gets structured guidance he can build on.
scenes.subtitle: For broader questions there is the AI legal assistant, a conversational chat that keeps context across messages. Daniel asks what a tenant can do when repair requests are ignored, and gets structured guidance he can build on.

scenes.title: Case predictor
scenes.narration: Finally, the case predictor reads a case brief and estimates the client's chance of winning, giving the lawyer a quick second opinion before going to court.
scenes.subtitle: Finally, the case predictor reads a case brief and estimates the client's chance of winning, giving the lawyer a quick second opinion before going to court.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.narration: LegalMind is built with React, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Gemini and Pinecone. The full source code is on GitHub.
scenes.subtitle: LegalMind is built with React, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Gemini and Pinecone. The full source code is on GitHub.
